reviews.text: 이 태국 음식점은 한국사람 취향은 아니네요. 전체적으로 음식이 너무 짜고, 재료을 충분히 사용하지 않는 빈약한 스타일입니다. Tom Yam은 절대 시키지마세요. 조미료만으로 맛을 낸 맛이고, Tom Yam의 주 재료인 코코넛밀크와 레몬그라스, 라임 잎파리가 전혀 들어가 있지 않습니다. 많이 실망스럽네요.

My wife and my first time at this establishment. A couple major issues. Tried not to worry when we walked in and were the only ones there, maybe we just missed a rush. AC either broken or just not low enough, okay we drink alot of water.

Big issue: ordered a Pork Pad Thai, and as soon as it was placed in front of me I knew there was something wrong, smelled off, looked off, noodles appeared either really overcooked or slimy for some reason, my wife confirmed that for rice based noodles that is kind of unheard of. It was confirmed with the taste, pork maybe tasted sour, could not pinpoint exactly what was wrong but it was very bad!!!

And yes, I’ve had Thai food and Pad Thai a million times. I am currently dealing with potential food poisoning and can’t get the taste/smell out of my sinuses. I was as nice as I could be when sending it back, and replaced it with a basil fried rice because I had already tasted my wife’s and it was good. I don’t think they believed me as she said the cook did not see any problems with it, now I’m definitely sure I wouldn’t go there again. It takes alot to hold back what I want to call what they served me, because I believe in being civil when I can! Food gets a 2 because the Basil Fried Rice was still pretty good, service was decent so it gets a 3, AC broken so atmosphere gets a 2.

⭐️ 1/5 — I would NOT recommend this restaurant

I’ve been to PD Thai several times in the past, and unfortunately, this visit was so disappointing that I would strongly recommend choosing another restaurant.

The problems were not limited to the food. What was most disappointing was the way management handled legitimate concerns.

1. Extremely hot inside
The restaurant was uncomfortably hot, and I was literally sweating while sitting at the table. I asked multiple times for the temperature to be lowered, but nothing was done. I eventually had to borrow the menu to use it as a hand fan. This alone made the dining experience very unpleasant.

2. Khao soi portion was significantly smaller
The khao soi portion was noticeably smaller than on my previous visits — approximately half the portion I remember receiving before. Considering the price, this was very disappointing.

3. Shrimp pricing discrepancy and misleading explanation
This was especially frustrating. The waiter initially told me that adding shrimp would cost $2 extra. I was then charged $3.

Afterward, I checked the restaurant’s website and menu, which both show the shrimp add-on as $2, not $3.

When I questioned the charge, the waiter said she would speak with the manager but never came back. I had to approach the manager myself.

Instead of addressing the discrepancy, the manager told me that the shrimp price had been updated. That explanation does not match the $2 price currently displayed on the restaurant’s own website and menu. From my perspective, I was given an explanation that was simply not consistent with the restaurant’s published pricing.

The shrimp itself was also different from my previous visits. Previously, it came without the shell and tail. This time, it had both shell and tail, and there were only 3–4 pieces.

4. Curry fried rice was very poor
The rice was extremely hard and chewy, with pieces that felt almost like hard sticks rather than properly cooked fried rice. It seemed as though the rice had been sitting for a long time or had not been properly thawed/reheated. There was also far too much sauce, which overwhelmed the other flavors.

5. Management response was the biggest disappointment
There is a board at the restaurant stating that there has been a change in management. Since the food and overall experience were noticeably different from my previous visits, I asked if I could speak with the chef. The manager refused and insisted that nothing had changed.

I also did not recognize any of the current staff from my previous visits.

Restaurants can have an off day, but customers should at least be able to raise concerns and receive an honest, respectful response. In this case, I experienced poor food quality, reduced portions, a pricing discrepancy, and a manager who was dismissive rather than helpful.

If you’re deciding where to eat in Austin, I would strongly recommend choosing another Thai restaurant. Based on this experience, I will not be returning to PD Thai.
good soup but i ordered the wrong one and when i wanted to fix it they said no and i was obligated to buy the wrong one, very weird

Great Thai food for a delicious bite. The Basil fried rice and pad Thai noodles were both delicious. They had excellent seasoning and fresh veggies.

Edit: Ordered to go for the first time and the quality of food seems to be lower?! There seemed to be less sauce and flavor. A bit disappointing.

Edit2: Tried the pad see ew again in store and it was delicious.
Great value for the food with a deal from Uber Eats! Order was ready super fast (less than 10 minutes). Found the pad thai to be too sour but that's just personal preference
All the food that I eat is very delicious
The delicious fresh food,the great customer service and very affordable meals will keep me coming back. This is a must try place. Love it!
The restaurant was very clean and quiet. Very enjoyable. Food came rapidly, was super fresh and very yummy. We recommend the place !!

As a tourist visiting Austin, I was eager to try this place since I heard good things. I ordered the pad ginger with chicken and pad cashew with chicken and baby corn. Pad ginger had no chicken and pad cashew had no cashews or corn which is the entire reason I requested the dish. When I requested a refund the following day and explained the situation, I was told that “that wasn’t here”. I then had to drive 25 minutes from my hotel to prove that the entire order was wrong even with photos of the dishes, to then only get half a refund.  Food and service mid af

The lady who answers the phone took my order.  She is very sweet and my order is always ready.  I tend to call instead of making the order online so I can pay cash.  I am very glad this restaurant is here as some of the Thai restaurants in Austin are lacking......
Super friendly staff and great food! I recommend coming here
Great food and exceptional service! Everyone here was so nice :)
The food was so good, and the service was great!
Recommended and is open EVERYDAY!!!
Really emphasize if you dont want egg or fish sauce.. ! Surprisingly low awareness of veganism considering nori is nextdoor
Great food! It might not have been the best look from the outside but, the food and service made up for all of it, 100%
Absolutely a great place!!!
Sofia was very professional thank you so much
They are the best
Got the chicken pad Thai add Shrimp. Really good. But there was only like 3 or 4 pieces of shrimp. I felt it was a little sparse. Should be like 6 pieces of shrimp or so.
The food here is absolutely delicious.

Ordered delivery. Food is ok, all is messed up with how spicy it is. I asked for level 2 out of 5 I believe, but it was so spicy that it’s impossible to eat and actually taste it. And why not to put at least chopsticks to the bag, not even saying about napkins
This is one of my favorite Thai places in Austin. The prices are reasonable and the quality is very good. I'm not Thai, but I love Thai food and this place  rocks!

PD Thai is one of our favorite restaurants! We drive all the way across town just to eat here because it's absolutely worth it. The food is always fresh, flavorful, and tastes incredibly authentic.

Our favorites are the Salmon Curry and the Pad Kee Mao, both are absolutely delicious and never disappoint. A special thank you to the manager, Hez, who is so welcoming, attentive, and makes sure every visit is a great experience!

If you're looking for authentic Thai food with amazing service, I highly recommend PD Thai. We'll definitely keep coming back!

We took a detour and found this place! Total gem! We got the yellow curry, pad Thai and basil fried rice. Everything was excellent! The curry was the best I’ve ever had and we eat Thai a lot! The owner was super sweet and hospitable. Go support this amazing restaurant!

Had the basil fried rice with chicken and the Pad Thai with chicken and extra fried tofu. The basil fried rice was excellent. Fresh vegetables, great flavor, and the rice had that perfect wok-fried texture. Everything was cooked exactly right!! As someone who loves fried rice, this is easily 9.5 out of 10!  I'm usually skeptical of Pad Thai at new places, but this one was delicious. I'll definitely be back soon to see if it's as consistent as my first visit. The restaurant was very clean, smelled great, and had a comfortable atmosphere. The food came out fast, hot, and tasted incredibly fresh. I'll definitely be back soon!
Yummy Thai food! Chicken green curry and pad sew was amazing! Good portions and reasonable prices.
Amazing food and service! Highly recommend.
Always on point!!

I am not Thai- but out of the other Thai places I have tried in Austin, I think their Pad Thai and Yellow Coconut Curry is superior. I know that this establishment is Thai-family-owned and operated and that they use traditional recipes that have been passed down to them. This alone is something of high honor and appreciation. I frequent this place often and have never felt unsatisfied. The atmosphere is casual and laid back. Their main course portions are big and worth the price. Their appetizers are a bit small (crunchy roles come with only two split in half, dumplings only 4; one app is enough for about 4 bites per person when shared between two people- so prepare to adjust accordingly)

I live in Las Vegas and was here in Austin for a work assignment. A coworker who is a local here recommended this place and I was very satisfied!! The service was amazing, quality ingredients for the food and the atmosphere felt like eating at a friend's house.  I highly recommend for anyone who wants to match their money to a great meal.
Great service and even better food.
Spicy chicken pad Thai is amazing staff is wonderful!
Best Thai place in Austin
Lots of MSG but the food is yummy!
The taste surpassed our highest expectations. We received the fresh food much faster than anticipated.  All the sauces were delicious and the service was delightful.

Second time here and the food has been consistently good. We got the pad see ew and the satay chicken skewers and both tasted great! This Thai place is one of Austin’s underrated. Highly recommend giving them a try, especially since there’s no wait and the prices are very reasonable. Will be back!
Food was great and flavorful. Got the pad see ew and the chicken satay.
I did take out. Pick up was easy. Food was yummy.
We got the pad thai and the mango sticky rice and both were soo good!
The food is sooooo tasty and delicious and creamy and filling and affordable. I love the pad see kha i think it’s called and it’s only like $15! Highly recommend this place and come all the time

Tried PD Thai Restaurant and really enjoyed it. The food is flavorful and tastes fresh, with everything coming out just right. It's a great spot when you're craving something comforting but still well made. The service was friendly and made the experience smooth. I'd definitely come back again.

Bonus points for being open so late, I strolled in at midnight and scored a Thom Yum-K variant, Super Wings that had an epic sauce, and a Pad Woon Sen with shrimp that was very unique and rightous. Felt great after, and super enjoyable!
Food and customer service is always amazing! I love coming here :)

AUTHENTIC!! Spicy, flavorful and just what I needed to try to kick my sinus issues. Owner is a sweet lady and her husband. She said he husband trained under a chef for 16 years. The Tom Yum soup was as good as Seattle WA, near UW campus.

You know when you get like that taste in your mouth that just goes mmmm...yummers... It hits that spot that makes you go this is going to make me feel better.

It had some real heat, tanginess that I haven't found in a long time. That's saying a lot. I also splurged and got the Green Curry lunch special with Jasmine Rice.

Sorry for the empty bowl picture. I scarfed it down. My sinuses immediately opened up and drained.

As someone who is Thai, the food is pretty decent. I ordered Tom yum noodles, pad Thai, yellow curry, and red curry. The tom yum definitely lacks in lemongrass. Pad Thai is pretty decent. The curry is good though! Service is lacking though… good overall is like a 7/10
Love this place,food was amazing

Was craving tofu and rice noodles. Not sure what I got? The noodles were not rice noodles, the tofu  tasted as it had been under a heat lamp too long and the noodles were not very fresh either. Very pasty as well. I was very disappointed especially because I trashed it (so waste of my time and $$). It was inedible. Will not be going back. :(
Always delicious, the pad see ew with todu is my fav!!
The food is good and the people are friendly.  I appreciate. If I have special dietary requests they are always helpful.

i love pd thai so much. yes it’s open late (which is awesome) but it’s not just for late night food! it’s awesome all the time. the prices are pretty good and the portions are generous. it’s comfort food!
The curry was so delicious and portions were big! Also open late which is great!
We love this spot for Thai! Late night blessing!

The steamed dumplings are amazing! More filling than dumpling dough which I appreciate and the sauce is amazing! The gang panang (panang curry) with chicken is delicious and has the perfect amount of spice for me! The fried rice is also delicious. One of my top two favorite places for Thai takeout! Highly highly recommend!!!
The food always tastes fresh and is hot! My favorite is the pad se ew. Portions are plentiful that if I order for dinner I can have leftovers for lunch the next day. Definitely recommend!
Phenomenal tasting food, always piping hot and freshly cooked. Always nice convo with their staff and a nice natural light, quiet dining room to have my lunch.  Love to eat here+
Always delicious!

Really tasty food and prompt service.
Recommend the basil fried rice.
This is one of my go-to spots! I always get the pineapple fried rice with tofu. It’s always hot and amazing! 10/10
Came in for a quick and delicious lunch. Got the chicken and noddles lunch special.

I loved this place. I've been ordering their food from Uber eats and doordash for a long time now and decided to go check out the place. They restaurant has a very quaint vibe! Very homely and comfortable; the kind of place you'd want to eat after a tough day at work. The food, needless to say is delicious! It tastes authentic and is very much affordable. The portion sizes are pretty good too!
They have amazing food with lots of flavor but when you simply ask for a side of extra sauce or veggies they act like they don't want to give it to you. (This is after hours, late night).
Not expensive and good food

I’ve tried the duck curry, pad see ew, and summer rolls.

The duck curry was fine, though the meat was on the dry side.

The pad see ew tasted super salty and seemed to be missing the usual balance of sauces. Thought about throwing it away, but ended up adjusting it at home with vinegar, sugar, and water to make it edible. Even with that, the incredible amount of soy sauce gave me a stomach ache that lasted about a day. (And soy sauce is a very regular part of my everyday cooking.)

The summer rolls were incredibly disappointing. Each piece had a single shrimp, and the portion size was about 1/3 of what most places offer.

Staff were friendly, and the restaurant itself is super quiet/mainly a takeout place. Unfortunately, I can’t recommend it.
We always just do takeout but they are consistently good! Order is always ready on time and they never make mistakes. If you order directly from their website they give you a discount too.

Very good food! We had veg basil fried rice and cashew veg curry (both with soft/fresh) tofu
Awesome food and service.
Ask for their hot oil chili on the side - super hot and yum!
Great tasting pad Thai prepared quickly - highly recommend!
Excelentela comida muy rica y no soy a mante a ese tipo de comida pero estaba bien rica
Super delicious food 😋
The food is really tasty, with lots of vegan options and fair prices. The staff are very kind and welcoming. We’ve definitely become regular customers!
Delicious and fast!
Amazing food and service with very reasonable price. I went to Austin to drop my daughter for her college and randomly picked this really good restaurant.

No disrespect but the owner and cook weren't from Thailand and therefore the food was not desirable when I had a taste for Thai food. She was sweet but there was just no comparison to true Thai food... I got the food to go and was very disappointed
Large portions, delicious food, and great prices. Would recommend for anyone looking for good Austin dining spots!

After a late flight, PD Thai was a lifesaver being open until 3am. Around 1am I couldn’t find food anywhere in North Austin, and this was the only spot still serving. Just know it’s strictly takeout late at night; front looks closed with lights off and chairs up, but if you go to the white door next to the glass door, that’s where you order. Everly was super kind and let me check the menu.

Food-wise: I got the Pad Thai ($14) and the sea bass with veggies ($30). Portions were on the smaller side for the price, and packaging could be better—- they stacked cold mango sticky rice on top of the steaming hot Pad Thai, so it didn’t travel well. When the door opened I noticed the kitchen looked a bit messy, but that’s not surprising for a place serving into the early hours.

Overall: food was decent and I was just grateful to find a hot meal after traveling. Not perfect, but a solid late-night option when everything else is shut down.
Super reliable Thai place - I love all of their curries. I order takeout from here pretty frequently and every single time the order is ready within ~10 minutes - very consistent.
Amazing food at amazing prices!

This place has a very humble and authentic Thai atmosphere. The basil fried rice with shrimp was out of this world good! Bursting with flavour and depth of spices, it was definitely the best fried rice I've had in Austin yet. The mango sticky rice paled a bit in comparison. The mango was sweet and sour, not like the ones you get year round in Thailand, and I prefer the rice to be a little less mushy. Overall though, it was a delicious meal and I'm definitely going back.
basil fried rice and pad prik khing are hella nice

We had a pickup order with a variety of entrees.  The pad thai with tofu was delicious with a bit of a smoky flavor - very good.  The papaya som tum salad was also quite good with a nice fresh blend of sweet and spice.  Also delicious was the gang dang curry.
I enjoyed the chicken Massaman (better than another nearby Thai restaurant) and my husband liked the basil fried rice.

One of the best Thai food I have tried so far so fresh and tasty, the restaurant is very clean. the owner is very friendly and he make sure we liked the food will definitely come back again, we ordered pad Thai and the thin noodle with beef stake and basil rice with shrimp it was amazing
nice people, good food

Beware: the menu does not reflect full ingredients.
I recently visited with a party of four and ordered three items. One of the dishes I ordered was a soup that arrived with ingredients not listed on the menu—including tomatoes and bits of onion, even though I had specifically requested no onions. More concerning, one person in my party has a mushroom allergy, and when I asked the server about that ingredient, they confirmed the soup did contain mushrooms—again, not listed anywhere on the menu.
To make matters worse, there was a shift change during our meal, and no server was available when the food arrived. With no one to speak to and having waited a while, I started eating. While the soup was edible, it wasn’t particularly enjoyable, and the presence of unexpected ingredients made it frustrating for the whole table.
There was no meaningful apology—just a suggestion to “let someone know next time.” But who are we supposed to tell when there’s no server around and the food has already been served after a wait?
If the kitchen and menu aren’t aligned, the least the restaurant can do is ensure staff are available to answer questions or address concerns when food arrives. I’m not completely sure I’d like to give this restaurant another try.
I always order their wonton soup and fried rice through Doordash. The food is always fresh 😇

Don’t be fooled by its humble appearance—this is an incredibly delicious hidden gem. I honestly think it’s one of the most authentic Thai restaurants in the area. I still remember the first time I came here—it was late at night and this was the only non-fast-food place open. I was blown away by how good it was. Their food has that unmistakable flavor, not something pre-made and reheated. You have to try their fried rice and noodle dishes. If you’re a fan of Thai curry, theirs is rich and flavorful. And whatever you do, don’t skip the mango sticky rice—it’s the best I’ve ever had. The purple sticky rice was a wonderful surprise, and it’s clearly freshly made, not something that’s been sitting in the fridge.

It was not as good as Mueller Pad Thai but it was still tasty hot and flavourful.  I didn't care for the Dumplings they were bland and if you ever try Mueller theirs are award winning.  ( I gave them the award) this locations Gang Garee was very good slightly different it had more cinnamon maybe not sure what the curry blend consists of.  All in all it was good and worth the money.  They gave me a nice size portion.
We ordered takeout from here and it was so good! Green curry was particularly flavorful. Pad see ew was also really good. Ready super fast, about 10-15 minutes. Highly recommend.
I ordered takeout on a friend’s recommendation. Got the pad thai, pad gra prao, and green curry.  Everything was far too sweet for our liking and the pad thai quite sour.
点了牛肉炒米粉和绿咖喱，都很好吃，花生牛奶超级香！

I almost forgot to take pictures. Tastiest Thai I've had in awhile. Fresh and perfectly cooked. I started with what I think of as spring rolls. They were beautifully presented and chilled. The peanut sauce was yummy with a slight sweet taste.
The Tom Yum was perfect. I'll be back
Yellow curry is perfect
Green curry was amazing, well seasoned/spiced and lots of chicken and veggies. Attentive staff. Will come back for the lunch specials!

1st time here , visiting Austin on a work contract and always looking for something good to eat , Pad Thai I must say has fulfilled that mission. I ordered the pineapple fried rice with shrimp level 3 spicy …. delicious !!!! While most restaurants skimp on the shrimp, they did not , it was wayyy more than I expected …..Will definitely be going back !

* Call ahead to order for the correct pricing because online prices are different *
So tasty and HUGE portions for a good price. 👍
Pad thai and my husbands plate were delicious. We got 4/5 spicy and the flavor was perfect
Wonderful flavors! Great service and atmosphere.
Pineapple fried rice is really good
Delicious food (Pad kee mow level 2) and excellent service
Pretty decent Thai food for a small little town, service was amazing, and the place was packed. I just wish they had Pineapple fried rice on the menu. But it is always good to try something else
the fresh rolls were exceptional.  My Panang curry was also delicious.  I ordered both with soft tofu.
Ordered Uber eats , got shrimp pad Thai and the 4 super overcooked shrimp w tail on and not cleaned  over cooked noodles as well , no plastic wear to eat either , better places out there .
great food at a fair price with reasonable portions. Awesome local spot. Massam curry is awesome

Fried rice was good but green curry was terrible - no flavor at all

Customer service was good - they took back the curry so that's appreciated

Incredible quality Thai food at very reasonable prices. I've come back multiple times since ordering DoorDash late night last week. Their fresh rolls with tofu are always very fresh and the peanut sauce is perfect. The fried tofu in their entrees is delicious and exactly what I want as a plant based protein alternate. Got the green curry today and it was perfect. Lots of fried tofu, perfectly cooked eggplant, lots of bamboo shoots and bell peppers. I really don't understand why this place is so empty.

EDIT: zero stars because this place exploits CHILD LABOR. A 13 year old boy served my water, waited on me during my meal and rang up my order on the computer system. His mother only stepped in when he overcharged me. Please do not eat here.
Curry is amazing, must try

Very calm atmosphere and the food was well seasoned and tender
The noodles were velvety and it didn’t take long at all to bring to the table
Grest food. Price great. Service great. 1st time. We definitely go back when we can.
delicious!
Very tasty food and good service!  Highly recommend this place!
Great food and great service!  Highly recommend for this place!

The atmosphere could use some work but the owner is sooo kind (Guatemalan owned!) and I fell in love with the dish I ordered. Do yourself a favor and order the panang curry (I ordered spice level 3). It is flavor packed, and tastes fresh. I will definitely order again.
Ordered the pad see ew for take out and was given the pad thai. Great pad thai, though. Would order again for late night thai food.
They are so cheap on service ,time or everything

Food was good and it was thanksgiving so i was glad they were even open but I likely won’t go back. We were a party of three and were ready to go. We waited for 15 minutes and i decided to write out how we were splitting the bill clearly with names and amounts on the back of the receipt. It didn’t get any easier. One paid cash and two cards. Spelled out plain as day and the guy BUTCHERED MY WORK. Split it up all wrong and charged everyone different from what I had plainly written. Basic reading was all it took and you need that because people get mad when you charge them wrong. Color me annoyed.

I was so excited to try this place as there are so few late night restaurants in Austin. The quality of the food was very sad. The panang curry with shrimp had a stale smell to it -- and so watery. It's clear they're just mixing flavor packets with quick ingredients lying around. The calamari also did not taste fresh. I felt bad complaining because the server also looked new.

One of my favorite restaurants in town and a go to place for Thai food. We’ve tried many items on the menu from the red curry to pad Thai to Tom yum and we’re always impressed with the flavor. The lady running the store is very friendly and hard working and the decorations in the restaurant reflects good taste.
Delicious flavorful food. Would definitely be back.
“Under new management” yeah that’s apparent. Trash.
The Panang chicken is so good! I love this place. They always have good quality food and service. Arnaldo has great customer service skills. Yum

The drunken noodles were so fresh and flavorful!
My only problem with the steamed dumplings is that I didn’t buy more.
Easy 10/10 for me.

I got the Pad Woon Sen and I’ve had better, but by no means was it bad. This place is close to me and the food is tasty but I feel like it lacks in thai flavor a bit. Dishes are reasonably priced and the staff is friendly.
Incompetent staff

The worst Thai we've had in Austin. Ordered shrimp pad woon sen that was extremely greasy and the shrimp weren't deveined. The pad that was greasy and crammed into a far too small plastic container so everything was crushed into a shapeless blob.
Canceled my to-go order after I arrived and wasted my time.
Great food. Worth it. I see people doing more takeouts.
great food and great staff!! the owner, arnaldo, was the best!!!!

We get takeout from here pretty often. The service and food are great. Our only complaint is we always have to prepare our own rice when we get food from here because the rice portions are so small. Much smaller than other restaurants. Other than that, no complaints!

The food was good, and the decor was nice!
We got the red curry and green curry. Level 4 was reasonable for the green curry. I got mild for my red curry and it still had spice but it was a nice level. If you can't handle any spice I wouldn't recommend these though. I really enjoyed them :)

The pork dumplings and the fried calamari were also good apps. And the mango sticky rice was great.
I wish I had taken a picture of the food but I ate everything so fast I forgot.😖 The chicken satay, green curry, and tom kha chicken are deliiiiiish 10/10  place is really clean too
Specifically noted a soy allergy and they put tofu in my pad Thai. What I ate before I discovered the tofu was okay.

It’s been a while since I’ve had truly great Thai food, and PD Thai Restaurant did not disappoint. The dishes were simply delicious! I highly recommend the Pineapple Fried Rice and Flat Stir-Fried Noodles. For a more authentic experience, ask for spice level 2 – it adds just the right kick without overpowering the flavors
when they say spicy they mean it!!
We always order curry, which they make so quickly & deliciously! We love PD Thai🤍
Really terrific food! Will definitely be coming back.
Must try their basil fried rice.  🤤
Nothing like Mexican Thai food, I tell ya. All that wonderful Tom Yum flavor, but with big chunks of onion and cilantro thrown in. Delish.
Food is okay, not that flavorful. Got there on hot afternoon, air conditioning was set to high, not comfortable and they charged me additional fee for using credit card
Very tasty food. The atmosphere and ambience can use some work, but they said they are new management, so hoping for the best for them!!

Yall have a great crew. I wish I'd ask their names but the two Spanish speakers Wednesday at around 3am. Thank yall. Be blessed brothers. I'm just a driver but I definitely want to try yalls dishes sometime. The cooks look young but the smells from the food whatnot smells amazing. I'll definitely try your food at some point and be sure to tip generously. I'll also be sure not to place an order last second haha I know that's a pain( i use to work something similar). Thank yall so much. Next time I'll have to get their names and give them some props or kudos(I'll talk to the gm haha) on here and edit my post. Good stuff and much love they deserve a raise in my opinion. Y'all take care.

Pad see ew was very yummy and love the deep flavor of the Thai tea. Usually most places add too much cream but you could actually taste the tea here

Edit: I have since tried the green curry and pad Thai which are average although did find a hair in it.

The food here was actually really good, seems like they may have new management based on a sign we saw. The portions are large and the prices are pretty good for the amount of food and quality you receive. Absolutely recommend the Mango sticky rice for dessert!
Very tasty Forever Pad Thai with wonderful crispy pork on top.

My friends and I listened to Purple Rain while chatting, laughing and sweating because of the spice. They DO NOT hold back on the spicyness of their dishes, and my friends LOVED that. I had the lump crab fried rice with a 3 spicy level, my boyfriend had the pineapple friend rice with a 3 spicy level and our friends had the level 5 spices on their rice noodle and soup dishes! It was about $74 for 4 people and we also had the fried calamari as an appetizer!
We ordered take out and the food was good. When I went in to pickup the food it was ready bit I had to request eating utensils and the place pretty dinge!
Absolutely love this place, I went here for the first time around March and come back at least once a week to get the roasted chicken noodles. Food is great and the owner is amazing!
Amazing thai restaurant in Austin!! They also close late and are friendly and hardworking. The food is authentic thai and the prices are good.
the food is so good! the staff is very kind and polite. Great portions of authentic Thai food. Will be coming back often :)
Delicious take out

I ate here years ago and wasn't impressed. But I've been ordering takeout from here recently and it's really good.

The restaurant itself has a liminal space vibe, but everything I've ordered here recently was so tasty. (ex: green curry, pad see ew, spring rolls)

The waiter (also manager) came to the table and we wanted to order takeout and a beer for me to drink as we were going to wait 20min for the food to be ready. After waiting for menus, he never came back, but passed by another nearby table so we asked him if we could finally order and he said we could not order from the table if it was takeout and that we had to go to the cashier to order from there. So we went to the cashier table and I asked him why he couldn’t come to take our order at the table if I also wanted to order a beer there while waiting for the food. Keep in mind it is late for dinner and their restaurant was almost completely empty. He answered very rudely about not being able to take his little paper pad to the table to get our order (again not sure why when there were only 2 tables being served at the restaurant). My daughter was finishing ordering at the cashier and I was about to just leave it alone when I heard him again say rudely about how takeout had to be ordered at the cashier table and then I lost it and just told him to cancel our order that it was ridiculous that if he saw we wanted to sit and have a beer that he could not take our order at the same table.
Now if the restaurant was really busy I totally see how I should not take up a table waiting for takeout or how they could not even come to take my order but if the restaurant is dead and they are asking you and you’re the manager, really? I just don’t get it, as a business owner myself, we always try to please the customer especially if it’s a reasonable request.
So again the worst service ever, they never apologized or anything so my family and I will not be going back. After that we went to Titaya’s for Thai food which was really close and their service was top notch. They definitely did not disappoint, they were very busy, most tables were full and they very politely sat us down so we could order a drink while we ordered and waited for our takeout. We will be going back!

What I like most about this place was the personal service. I had the green papaya salad with shrimp and the waitress/manager/owner gave me so much information about how good green papaya is for me and how it could help with weight loss and overall health. She was very kind and the salad was delicious. I thanked her for not making it too spicy, too. There was a guy sitting across from me who was eating something that was making him cry. I didn't want that and she helped me because I told her I was new to ordering Thai food. It's close to home and there's always ample parking, even with the Five Guys in the adjacent section next to Pad Thai. I'll be going back soon.

Pad Thai is an anomaly in Austin because its a Thai restaurant that you can actually find parking at, which is especially key if you are stopping by to pick up take out.  I had the red curry and soft spring rolls and both were good. I'd say the food quality is similar to many other Thai restaurants in Austin.  It's good and what you would expect but probably not 100% authentic. I'll keep coming back because I can't find parking at places like Mai Thai or Madam Mam's.

I am a big fan of this place during weekday lunches. The reason being that they offer complimentary salad and soup. I enjoy their salad with their sweet peanut sauce. Their soups are decent as well (except the spicy soup depending what day they have it).

I like ordering the Pad Thai or the Pad See Ew, both are delicious and decent prices for lunch. I would recommend coming here for lunch during the weekday. If you go anytime otherwise, "No soup for you!"

Best Thai food around campus. Their Pad Kee Mao is my favorite dish ever. Lunch special is awesome with included salad and soup bar. You definitely get quality for your money.

This is my favorite place to go for thai food near campus. The people are always very nice, the food comes out in a timely manner, and it's always delicious. I've been so many times that a server there started to recognize me every time! Their black bean pudding (dessert) is SOOOO good. I get it every time, without fail. Their chicken satay is also quite good. While their tom kha soup used to be much better, it's still pretty good. Most people go to Madam Mam's on Guad, but going a few blocks further to Pad Thai is a MUCH better decision!
